evidence.title: Hut 8 Commercializes First Phase of 1 GW Beacon Point AI Data Center Campus with 15-Year, 352 MW IT Lease with Base-Term Contract Value of $9.8 Billion
evidence.excerpt: Hut 8 reports an executed 15-year lease for 352 MW of critical IT capacity in Beacon Point's first phase, an executed 1,000 MW campus interconnection agreement, and future AI training and inference use by the unnamed tenant.
